title: The Soul Auction
text: In a burning hall, devils bid on souls with raised clawed hands while the auctioneer chants. The lots are paraded on the stage in chains. The next is a Scion of your House, sold by a rival, screaming your name.

options.label: Outbid the devils whatever it costs; no Scion of yours will be sold.

outcomes.text: The soul is yours at a price. It weeps with relief.

options.label: The shrewdest steals the lot from the stage, chains and all.

outcomes.text: They slip out the back with it.
They are caught with the lot in their arms.

options.label: Let the gavel fall; you cannot save every soul.

outcomes.text: The gavel falls. The screaming goes on long after you leave.
